evidence: Structure rather than words: the text is a long chain of short formula units separated by dashes, with an isolated two-glyph abbreviation between dashes recurring 20+ times that I read as පෙ (pe, the Pali peyyala 'repetition omitted' mark) - this one I am fairly, not fully, sure of. Securely read whole words: 0; securely recognised recurring sign: 1 (පෙ).
note: A peyyala-abbreviated formula chain is a feature of Pali canonical texts (Patthana-like), not of Sinhala prose or a sanna, which is why this is 'yes' rather than 'unsure'. It is an inference from page structure; treat as unsure if the rule needs read words.
